capabilities: customize callout icon, color, title and fold state
save and reapply preset looks per callout
promote looks to custom callout types written to a CSS snippet
import and sanitize custom SVG icons
search the full Lucide icon set by name, tag and category
extras: The plugin intercepts Obsidian's internal rendered-callout context menu and calls the non-public app.customCss API to enable its snippet; the README flags the menu interception as most likely to break after major Obsidian updates. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+. Installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Right-click any callout in Obsidian to change its icon, color, title, and fold state - all without writing CSS.
problem: Changing a callout's icon or color normally requires writing CSS, and styles apply per callout type rather than to individual callouts.

relations.evidence: Icons from Lucide, ISC licensed. Icon metadata is bundled from the lucide-static package.

summary: Callout styling tool that changes a callout's icon, color, title and fold state from the right-click menu, storing the changes inline in the note.
